response.query: What are the top recent trends in engineering and computer science research, focusing on safety, reproducibility, domain adaptation, and real-time deployment in autonomous driving models?
response.answer: Recent trends focus on improving safety and reproducibility in autonomous driving, with emphasis on domain adaptation and real-time deployment. Researchers are developing brain-inspired intelligence and advanced deep learning models for better driving intention understanding. Efforts are also made to enhance model reproducibility and real-time processing capabilities.
